thread:
Taylor: Heads-up — we're planning to sunset the legacy top-level field `metadata` in the next API version. Need to align on expected client fallback behavior and an operational plan. @Maria can you advise on migration window and telemetry?
Maria: +1. Recommend a 6-week opt-in window with a warning header and a telemetry event for both `deprecated_field_seen` and `fallback_used`.
Jamal: Can we do an in-proxy transformation so most customers don't have to change immediately? That would reduce churn but adds infra surface area.
Sophie: We have a lightweight mapper in infra that can rewrite requests, but it increases memory/cpu slightly. I'd be comfortable rolling it out at low percentage first.
Taylor: Draft plan: 1) Add `X-Redwood-Deprecation: metadata` header when we see the old shape. 2) Enable a tenant runtime toggle that rewrites `metadata -> meta` server-side. 3) Canary the rewrite (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 4 weeks, then remove rewrite after 90 days.
Maria: Guardrails: rate-limit rewrites per-tenant, instrument rewrite success/failure, and create an ops runbook if rewrite error rate > 1%. Also emit a daily report of tenants still using `metadata`.
Jamal: Minimal rewrite snippet (pseudo-js):
```
if (payload.metadata) {
  payload.meta = payload.metadata;
  delete payload.metadata;
}
return payload;
```
Sophie: SDKs need a short-term compat flag too (JS/Python): `legacyMetadata: true`. That way customers can opt into client-side fallback while we run server-side rewrites.
deploy-bot: staging deploy for `mapper-service` succeeded — build 2026.03.21-72.
Taylor: I'll open an RFC PR with the rollout timeline and a changelog entry. Also plan a Console banner for tenants using the old field. Ops — @ops-oncall please add an alert for `rewrite_error_rate > 1%` and a dashboard card showing `deprecated_field_seen` by tenant.
ops-oncall: Alert + dashboard added (`rewrite-failure-rate`, `deprecated-field-usage`). I'll post runbook steps in #incidents too.
Maria: 👍 I'll add the telemetry events and a Grafana panel for migration velocity.
Jamal: We should publish a short migration guide with before/after payloads and SDK examples. I'll draft it and ping product for copy.
Taylor: Thanks all — next steps: RFC PR, runway ticket, SDK patches, console banner, canary plan. I'll assign owners and target the first canary next Monday.
